scope: Native Submodule Add source groups, histories/browse, hidden Branch, Force precedence, app/Finder action and icon, contained literal Git Add, explicit SSH private-agent loading/child remote key, captured progress/retry and closure/Quit fences.

verification.source: Reviewed pinned SubmoduleAddDlg.cpp/.h, IDD_SUBMODULE_ADD, SubmoduleCommand Add branch/header and MenuInfo SubmoduleAdd clause. Force replaces branch args in pinned source. Pageant preparation before Add and native key save on child origin are adapted to read-only grants/private agent. Blank key performs ordinary Add. Clipboard defaults and full source progress remain partial.
verification.core_system: 22 focused cases pass: SSHTransportPreparation 12, FinderCreationMenu 3, FinderMenuSettings 2 and FinderRepositoryMetadata 5. New real private-agent Add checks branch/custom literal Unicode/quoted path, child HEAD/key, staged 160000 gitlink, independent Windows/shell config, lifetime cleanup, canceled/missing preparation and source HEAD preservation. Pure arguments test covers absolute containment/invalid paths/empty branch/Force precedence. Finder test covers exactly one folder-in-Git clause and Add icon; Add does not require prior .gitmodules.
verification.core_bundled: 12 SSHTransportPreparation cases pass in bundled-engine run: 11 engine-selecting fixture cases and one pure arguments case. Other 10 Finder cases are not claimed as bundled-engine tests.
verification.native: Final expanded hidden receiver passes with system and bundled Git. Actual Add controller/model submits captured branch/path/key, rejects second apply, stages gitlink, matches source HEAD, stores native child key, blocks Quit while busy, releases private agent/mock grants and fences forced close/pending response/late selection/result. Synthetic 3000-line failed transport with 16-KiB display setting retains truncated bounded output, reports exit status, publishes no success and creates no child. Earlier SSH/Clone/remote refs/retry/CRLF cases also pass.
verification.corrections: Initial compile rejected multiple @Published bindings in a declaration; fields were split before final successful builds. Review found that native failure replaced bounded progress with full GitFailure text; fixed to retain stream/report exit status and verified the large-output failure with both engines.
verification.appstore: Final unsigned AppStore build passes for both architectures; app automatic SSH loading still unavailable without bundled OpenSSH agent/add.
verification.bundles: Both audits pass: Git/LFS where configured, EditorConfig, IssueRegex, askpass private one-use/provenance/linkage, embedded Finder, licenses and all 99 icons. Both embedded NOTICE files equal root; signed acceptance unverified.
verification.inventory_site_workflow: Pinned inventory regression and local site build pass. New Add source/header/resource mappings are partial. Safe YAML parse and expanded SSH receiver CI step present once; hosted CI/deployment unverified.
